This v2 declaration represents the actual held-out prediction matrix, observation mask, masked per-site correlation and support-count vectors, plus three retained printed scalar summaries. The original registered matched-control question remains mandatory and unresolved in full_panel, without an invented result category or control roster. Exact authentic coordinates, source-paper numerical/population mapping, historical split/cache/checkpoint, native derivation, author/control replay and scientific criteria remain unresolved. Earlier-audit assertions are not newly authenticated paper-body facts. Separate J17/J18/J19/full36 evidence neither replaces nor automatically gates this primary.

target.description: Original task.json retinal target: predict dendritic calcium of the supplied transient Off-alpha retinal ganglion cell from checkerboard stimulation using its detailed morphology. This is final published Figure 3, despite author directory nex/fig4_rgc and historical Fig4 labels. The broader 36-family implementation is retained and must not be declared won by this single endpoint.

dataset.description: Source retinal recording archive Ran et al. version 1.0 at Zenodo 3708064; cell 20161028_1. The exact historical avg_recordings.pkl cache, morphology-to-ROI joins and source artifact hashes remain unqualified.

cohort.description: One source retinal ganglion cell, with 15 recording fields and 147 model recording sites in the published aggregate. Methods describe 232 raw ROIs before source processing; the authentic 232-to-147 mapping must be recovered rather than selecting favorable sites.

split.description: Original held-out image evaluation with separate validation selection. Author build_dataloaders saves permuted split indices, but exact published run indices/configuration are unrecovered; config defaults are not evidence of the published split. Reduced-data Figure 3f has a different seven-field/512-test design and must stay separate.

inputs.description: Original checkerboard stimuli, training calcium labels, cell morphology and author model/input transformations. Final held-out calcium is scoring-only; fitted conductances need not identify biological truth.

preprocessing.description: Paper Methods use the first 1024 stimuli per field, 7-Hz lowpass calcium filtering, per-ROI standardization and 1.8-second label delay. Author loader merges compartment-assigned recording sites and masks unavailable labels; historical cache equivalence remains an execution gate.

metric.description: For each recording site compute Pearson correlation between predicted and observed held-out calcium on its valid mask; then take the arithmetic mean across the 147 sites. Training loss or neuron-simulator numerical agreement cannot replace this response-prediction score.

aggregation.description: Published mean held-out Pearson correlation across 147 recording sites of one cell. Sites, stimuli and fields are dependent measurements within that cell, not 147 independent biological replicates; the seven-field reduced-data result is a separate comparison.

full_panel.description: Retain the complete original supplied-cell stimulus-to-calcium held-out prediction result and the registered matched-control question. The retained contract specifies cell20161028_1, all15fields,1024source images per field,232rawROIs and147model sites; authenticate the historical realization, morphology-to-site correspondence, stimuli, response transforms, observation masks, train/validation/test identities, prediction vector and source-author comparator before qualification. Preserve anatomy/observation lineage necessary to define that computation without turning every illustrative anatomy or mechanism output into a separate success criterion. Resolve the original fixed/untrained OR constrained-parameter control membership, actual primary-source status and matched evaluation support; do not invent a roster, require both alternatives, choose the easiest alternative or silently substitute the separate seven-field comparison. J17 spatial calcium/voltage simulation, J18 measured/model receptive fields, J19 reduced-data learning results and the wider36-family/four-condition programme remain separately named source evidence. Their success is not automatically a gate on primary prediction, and primary prediction alone establishes no mechanistic validity, true conductance recovery, cross-cell generalization or whole-programme result. Represent the complete source-defined held-out prediction matrix, independently held observed calcium and operator-owned observation mask, with per-site Pearson and support-count vectors. Preserve every site and its undefined status; never pool observations across sites, weight by support counts, drop undefined sites, substitute training loss or choose a favorable subset. Exact test-row count and site coordinates are unresolved; neither a default128-row split nor fabricated147site labels are adopted. Final observed calcium and masks remain operator scoring operands, never additional candidate-visible inputs. The operator assembles metric/support outputs from the submitted predictions and independently held observations. The unknown registered control outcome is retained as a source-resolution obligation, not populated by a fabricated categorical finding.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same source paper, original checkerboard stimuli, morphology, training calcium and frozen validation mechanism with identical raw-ROI/site identities, transformations and final masks. Final held-out calcium is operator-scoring-only. The paper_data_author_code condition adds only the pinned author-code information; it does not add target arrays, alternate splits, extra fields,parameter-selection privileges or a different baseline. Paper figures and printed findings are exposed allowed inputs, so independent authentic-data execution and granular output verification are required to distinguish computation from aggregate copying.
